component.name: vinoPilot
component.summary: Install, update and uninstall the vinoPilot apps

description.p: One place to install, update and uninstall the vinoPilot apps: vinoWhisper, vinoAuthFace, vinoOpenEffects, vinoPop, vinoSpeak, vinoSearch, vinoWatch and ovfetch. Each app has its own hash-checked installer; vinoPilot knows which one to run, how each app got onto your machine, and whether there is something newer for that way in.
Nothing goes online until you press Check for updates.

screenshot.caption: The window: a card per app, with its version and how it was installed

ul.li: A .deb, an .rpm and a Flatpak on every release
vinoPilot updates and uninstalls itself as the package it came in
The version in the header checks for a newer vinoPilot, updates it and restarts the window
An About popup says how vinoPilot and its commands are installed
A warning when one copy of a command hides another
